newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 8.72 percent at Italy dollar repo.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 8.72 percent at Italy dollar repo.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's $3.0 billion Bank of Italy three-month repurchase tender was 8.72 percent against 8.76 percent at the previous three-month tender.
The average indicative rate was 8.74 percent from 8.77 percent at the last foreign currency-denominated repo for $4.0 billion on August 22.

The Bank said the tender was fully subscribed and the funds assigned at a minimum 12.05 forward points above the 1,514.50 lire per dollar floor set by the Bank of Italy. The Bank received 31 bids of which nine were met in full and two in part.
